thread.title: If a Good Apple Reaction and a Benign Fed Can't Boost This Market What Will?

title: If a Good Apple Reaction and a Benign Fed Can't Boost This Market What Will?
text:
If a Good Apple Reaction and a Benign Fed Can't Boost This Market What Will? By aapl
Both the earnings report from Apple ( AAPL ) and the interest-rate decision from the Fed were unsurprising but it didn't do much to help the market. While Apple did a nice job of holding on to its gains, that didn't seem to inspire the broader market. The Fed's policy statement was completely unsurprising, although the headlines unleashed some computer programs that took the indices up initially before then triggering a waterfall of selling into the close.
Tuesday afternoon the indices ran up and closed well for no particular reason. Today the action reversed and, once again, there was no compelling reason for the movement.
The bearish spin on this type of action is obvious. If a good reaction from Apple and a benign Fed can't boost this market then what will? In addition to positive news not helping the market, it is being used as an opportunity to sell.
The character of the price action is negative and that is the most important thing for us to keep in mind. The indices still have some technical support but when we have a poor close like this, then we have to wonder if it can hold. Earnings season is slowing down, negativity seasonality is kicking in and the market can't rally even on good news. There is reason to be worried. This was not positive action today.
